required_nodes.rationale: Proves exact definition and approval digests, definition-only registration, canonical visibility, and absence of grant, runtime authority, effects, or runtime mutation.
Proves later exact admission eligibility and rejection of missing or extra effects, wrong principal or subsystem, missing or forbidden goal scope, and an unregistered substitute capability.
Proves the registration task cannot request or exercise its registered capability, principal, or effects.
Proves the frozen machine-contract candidate reconstructs to the exact registered canonical definition without rewriting the frozen contract.
